# Junk Junkies Texas

> Junk removal, debris removal, hoarder cleanouts, appliance removal and moving in Spring, Klein, The Woodlands, Humble, Texas. Phone/text: (346) 413-9644.

## Services
- [Junk Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/junk-removal-spring-tx/): Furniture, boxes, old household items and general junk, hauled away.
- [Debris Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/debris-removal-spring-tx/): Construction, remodel, storm and yard debris cleared out fast.
- [Hoarder Cleanouts](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/hoarder-cleanouts-spring-tx/): Respectful, thorough cleanouts for heavily cluttered homes.
- [Appliance Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/appliance-removal-spring-tx/): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves and more removed.
- [Furniture Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/furniture-removal-spring-tx/): Couches, mattresses, dressers, tables and more picked up.
- [Appliance Installation](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/appliance-installation-spring-tx/): We haul away the old appliance and install the new one.
- [Local Moving](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/local-moving-spring-tx/): Local moves with a crew that handles the heavy lifting.
- [Long-Distance Moving](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/long-distance-moving-spring-tx/): Moves beyond the Houston area, handled start to finish.
- [Trampoline Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/trampoline-removal-spring-tx/): Trampolines taken down and hauled away, including damaged ones.
- [Basketball Goal Removal](https://junkjunkiestexas.com/basketball-goal-removal-spring-tx/): Portable and in-ground basketball goals removed and hauled.
